== Patch 1.2.14 ==
* Captain's Intuition should more reliably persist
* A recipe has been added to get the Soulforged Armor kits for those who lost or destroyed them.
* Fixed the display issue on family & guild quests rewards
* The inventory will now display a search bar in the bottom left
* The honor rewards for the Drill Camp arena have been increased greatly. Winning will grant 1000 honor and losing will grant 650 honor.
* The Ghastly Aura debuff applied when salvaging treasure chest has been made shorter. 2m >> 1m
* Anchoring Emblems will no longer be bound. Shards are not bound already and this step follows suit in our efforts to keep the market full of opportunities.
* Regrade Charms have been renamed to better reflect their rarity and effectiveness.
* Charms now contain the max rank they can be used on in their name.
* Charms with 1.5x chance will have no prefix, 1.75x chance will be "Dazzling", and 2x chance will be "Radiant".
* The Rum Runner Festival has ended
* Preparations for the anniversary event phase 1 which will start next Wednesday. It's delayed by a few days due to unforeseen real life circumstances for some of our team members.
* Conversion recipes have been added between types of regrade points. For example, 3 Starpoints into 1 Sunpoint. These conversions can be made at any Archeum Workbench
